description: A warning rule in an earlier stage cannot use a locally declared feature.

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text *f
%rule f A %warning "warning f"
%emits
%stage second
%features f
%conditions $.classes ∩ A ≠ ∅
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A

```
